assertion.statement: For the actual rational diamond quotient X_H and J_H, the nebentypus order satisfies t≤4608R, the index d_H satisfies d_H< T=2^14 C R^(19/6), and g=dim J_H<T with h_F(J_H)<2^24 T^6, where C=210^300.
assertion.objects: The final f, its nebentypus epsilon, H=ker epsilon, the rational modular curve X_H, its Jacobian and the same Lprime, R and level N.
assertion.hypotheses: The actual determinant square is cyclotomic squared on G_Lprime; the weight-two determinant convention is supplied. [Lprime:Q]≤2304R, N≤CR², radN dividesR and the effective quotient has g≥2. Published modular index/genus and general Belyi Jacobian height estimates are supplied.
assertion.quantifiers: For every actual non-CM instance of the H19 construction, with the same final form and field.
assertion.parameter_range: R≥1, arbitrary coefficient degree and arbitrary weight-two nebentypus; H contains−1.
assertion.uniformity: No coefficient-field degree factor or cyclotomic field extension enters the bounds.
assertion.normalizations: Use Tate determinant epsilon times cyclotomic; inverse-character convention has the same kernel and order. No factor2 in the modular index since−I is in Gamma_H. Original stable Faltings metric.
assertion.exceptional_cases: The Belyi estimate is general, with no squarefree-level or trivial-character hypothesis. The source factors and actual determinant restriction are required; bounds do not construct them.
assertion.limit_order: Bound epsilon order from its squared restriction; form the rational quotient; compute its index and Belyi degree; apply genus and height bounds to the same Jacobian.
